scripts.generate:voyager: node scripts/voyager-ephemeris.mjs && node scripts/voyager-source.mjs && biome format --write features/voyager/ephemeris-data.ts features/voyager/source-data.ts
scripts.generate:disco: uv run scripts/disco-originals.py && biome format --write features/disco/film-data.ts
scripts.generate:cobe: cd ../../../cobe && PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m cobe fetch --time-ordered && PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m cobe build && cd ../www/apps/www && biome format --write features/cobe/spectrum-data.ts
scripts.generate:cups: cd ../../../deepseek && cargo run --release --features accelerate --bin cups -- export target/cups/blurts-1.safetensors target/cups/blurts-2.safetensors target/cups/blurts-4.safetensors target/cups/blurts-8.safetensors target/cups/notes-1.safetensors && cd ../www/apps/www && biome format --write features/cups/readers-data.ts
scripts.generate:cups-glance: cd ../../../deepseek && cargo run --release --features accelerate --bin cups -- glance --count 100 && cd ../www/apps/www && biome format --write features/cups/glance-data.ts
scripts.generate:cups-recorded: cd ../../../deepseek && cargo run --release --features accelerate --bin cups -- record 4:1 8:1 12:1
scripts.generate:cups-forge: cd ../../../deepseek && cargo run --release --features accelerate --bin cups -- forge --count 20 --swaps 6 && cd ../www/apps/www && biome format --write features/cups/forge-data.ts
